strategy: causal market-state overlay with causal volatility target

decision.reason: The development-selected overlay met reused base and stress confirmation gates; fresh forward evidence remains required.

limitations: 2026 is reused confirmation evidence and is not a fresh holdout.
The market-state signal uses only the last complete prior UTC-day 4h snapshot.
Volatility estimates use only returns closed before each exposure day; split prefixes are retained as warmup.
Drawdown is measured at daily closes; borrowing cost and liquidation are not modeled.
